retreat.stop_reason: A single missing pose response triggered force-stop and queue clear. Twelve subsequent valid stationary pose/alarm readbacks and a camera image confirmed the stopped state; no automatic retry was performed.

restrictions: Keep robot powered and fixed to the table between A and B; use the physical Unlock control for manual teaching.
Do not move the camera or red block after choosing the B contact point.
Record B only after the suction cup gently contacts the block and the arm has stopped; leave suction off to avoid moving the block.
Record all vendor joints and yaw at B. Changes in wrist or base heading require checking whether the unknown tool-reference error still cancels.
A/B differences are provisional relative-displacement measurements, not a verified physical TCP or full camera-to-base calibration.
